title: V2 Full-Plan Residual Value — Oracle Gate, Learning & Closed-Loop Qualification v1
primary_objective: J_F physical cuff-force norm integral in N s
model: frozen strong P complete-current-repetition model; no predictor changes
candidate: full requested 2x5x3 K3 table at actual native request; mask issued rows by counts; same native certification/rejection/fallback

COMMITTED.target: actual complete current-repetition remaining J_F under fixed requested table minus frozen same-candidate full model prediction
COMMITTED.continuation: native-certified-committed-K3-suffix-v1; no performance replanning; certification/rejection/fallback retained

ROLLING_P.target: actual complete current-repetition remaining J_F after same first native row, then frozen P receding search, minus full model prediction for original candidate
ROLLING_P.continuation: audit seeded frozen-P continuation: after forced row, previous_plan=U; same issued counts/proposal history; carry explicitly in both generations; no G/V/V2; RNG state reconstructed from preregistered post-forcing seed

suitability_rule: Both must have causal input and reproducible requested-plan/receipt ownership. If both stable, choose ROLLING_P for actual receding-P deployment alignment BEFORE oracle scoring; COMMITTED remains diagnostic. Explicit seeded optimizer ownership is required; no claim to recover historical optimizer RNG stream.

oracle_rule.cost: P+true residual must equal measured cost exactly
oracle_rule.go: strictly positive accepted-pool top1 regret reduction / repaired P top1 at >=2 distinct saved parent snapshots; no newly damaged selection. One snapshot or only top-k reorder with unchanged selection cost is insufficient.
oracle_rule.fail: If primary oracle has no or single-parent selection benefit, V2_NOT_DECISION_RELEVANT; STOP, no regression fitting or new collection to rescue the gate.

feature_schema.current: 55D causal observation at actual request; explicit phase/task elapsed/reference/nominal request; estimated human state only
feature_schema.history: last issued K3 proposal; previous masked pending/carry table
feature_schema.candidate: masked complete pending K3 candidate, issued counts, valid mask
feature_schema.human: commissioned beta/geometry and frozen research effective beta/geometry, model version
feature_schema.ownership: native causal request projection; frozen P method, carry/search initialized flag and exact causal RNG state/seed; snapshot hashes are provenance ONLY
feature_schema.network_input_not_selected_yet: deterministic flattened causal representation; no TRAIN/DEV/TEST dataset or normalization before oracle PASS

split_contract: entire parent snapshot and all its candidate rows share one TRAIN/DEV/HELDOUT_TEST group; adjacent native rows are not independent states; no splits or fitting before oracle PASS
closed_loop_gate: oracle PASS + heldout selected-action regret/ranking better than P/V1 + leakage checks
promotion: oracle leverage + heldout closer to oracle + qualified closed loop without systematic loss and consistent improvements at identical candidate budgets
repetition: V_n only from now to END of repetition n; memory may persist as plan/outcomes/prior/dataset/V parameters/Human belief; future adaptation benefit and repetitions excluded; no online adaptation implementation
